notes: Round 10 runs several tracks at once, each in its own worktree: M1 (land animals), M2 (water mobs), M3 (night mobs) and W's w3 (the game events W's first merge left out). D0's d0b (silverfish in stone, endermites from pearls, flying navigation) is merged (c0366f3a), and release 6 is built with PROTOCOL 11 (789f6d23). Never bump minecraft_net::PROTOCOL: the release step bumps it once when messages changed; if a commit changes a ToClient/ToServer message or the codec, add a line under '## Protocol' in the track log. Insert new match arms and list entries next to related ones, not at the end of lists, to keep merges small (E3-0 names the few positional lists that are appended). Record decisions in the track log. LOAD: builds run at -j 4 per slot to keep the laptop cool; never start a second cargo command, the game, or any other long CPU-heavy process. Keep to the brief: each section names the commit its file:line anchors come from, so re-check every anchor before editing; keep off the hooks the M briefs own and follow the cross-area overlaps (both in E3-0). E2's e2b (44d96765) and D0's d0b (c0366f3a) are merged, so every 'waits for e2b', 'after d0b' and 'release 6 built' in the brief is met; d0b moved lines in server.rs, world.rs, walk_path.rs, entity_view.rs and families.rs, so anchors taken before it need a re-check. The orchestrator brings track-e3 up to minecraft-survival before each segment, so the review uses git diff r10-e3v-base..HEAD as usual. Track E3 group draw-ride-heads: build track-e3.md section E3-15 group draw-ride-heads.

One commit: "Worn Minecraft heads move with the gait of the mount a player rides".

Key points:
- Vanilla LivingEntityRenderer.extractRenderState (offsets 145-186) takes wornHeadAnimationPos from a LivingEntity vehicle's walkAnimation.
- Every rideable vehicle in the fork is a living mob, and the rider's seat moves with it. sim::frame::ride (crates/sim/src/frame.rs:465-480) zeroes the velocity, so use origin deltas.
- minecraft_glide.rs:
  - GlideInput gets origin (ps.origin in blocks).
  - BodyGlide gets ride_walk: WalkAnimation and ride_from. While riding and alive, each walk tick updates ride_walk with the seat's horizontal move split over this frame's ticks. Off the mount, ride_from is cleared and ride_walk stops.
  - head_swing() returns ride_walk's position while riding and walk_position() otherwise.
- minecraft_gear.rs:534 uses glide.head_swing(body.client).
- Host and friend both run step_body_glides on the presented snapshot.
- Log that a flying mount (M3's happy ghast) uses the horizontal walk.
- Tests and owner steps as in the brief.
- No comments. Edits change only the lines they need.
